claims: Venezuela defeated Trinidad and Tobago 4-1 on March 27, 2026, in a FIFA Series international friendly held in Tashkent, Uzbekistan, according to reports from ESPN and FIFA+.
The Venezuela vs. Trinidad and Tobago match on March 27, 2026 was held at Pakhtakor Central Stadium in Tashkent, Uzbekistan, noted FIFA+.
The result of the Venezuela vs. Trinidad and Tobago match on March 27, 2026 was Venezuela 4-1 Trinidad and Tobago, per YouTube.
Delvin Alfonzo scored to break a 1-1 tie in the second half of the Venezuela vs. Trinidad and Tobago match on March 27, 2026, says VAVEL.com.
The Venezuela vs. Trinidad and Tobago match on March 27, 2026 is part of the 2026 FIFA Series international friendlies, detailed in a YouTube video and reported by Sports Mole.
Venezuela was led by coach Oswaldo Vizcarrondo with a 4-4-2 formation in the match on March 27, 2026, says BBC Sport.
Trinidad and Tobago was managed by Angus Eve in the match on March 27, 2026, according to Sports Mole.
Trinidad and Tobago featured players Justin Garcia and Levi Garcia in the match on March 27, 2026, according to Sports Mole.
Migrationpolicy.org notes thousands of Venezuelans have migrated to Trinidad and Tobago due to the crisis in their home country.
